examples.text_en: The small hatchling was kept in a big box.
examples.text_zh: 这只小幼雏被放在一个大盒子里。

examples.text_en: We saw a hatchling near the water.
examples.text_zh: 我们在水边看到一只幼雏。

examples.text_en: His hateful words made her feel very sad.
examples.text_zh: 他可恨的话让她非常难过。

examples.text_en: It was a hateful thing to say to a friend.
examples.text_zh: 对朋友说这种话是很可恨的。

examples.text_en: His hatred for the old man was clear to us.
examples.text_zh: 他对那个老人的憎恨我们都看得出来。

examples.text_en: The war left a deep hatred in her heart.
examples.text_zh: 战争在她心里留下了深深的仇恨。

examples.text_en: The haughty man would not talk to us.
examples.text_zh: 那个傲慢的男人不愿和我们说话。

examples.text_en: She gave a haughty answer and walked away.
examples.text_zh: 她傲慢地回答了一句就走开了。

examples.text_en: They made a long haul across the open land.
examples.text_zh: 他们长途拖运穿过开阔地带。

examples.text_en: The haul of food was enough for the week.
examples.text_zh: 运来的食物够吃一星期了。

examples.text_en: The old house was a haunt of young people.
examples.text_zh: 这座老房子是年轻人常去的地方。

examples.text_en: This place is a haunt for many small birds.
examples.text_zh: 这里是许多小鸟栖息的地方。

examples.text_en: His hauteur made him few friends.
examples.text_zh: 他的傲慢使他朋友不多。

examples.text_en: She spoke with a hauteur that was hard to like.
examples.text_zh: 她说话时带着一种难以让人喜欢的傲慢。

examples.text_en: The long war caused havoc in the small town.
examples.text_zh: 漫长的战争给小镇带来了大破坏。

examples.text_en: The rain made havoc of the whole field.
examples.text_zh: 大雨把整片田野弄得一片狼藉。

examples.text_en: The hawker called out to people in the street.
examples.text_zh: 小贩在街上向人们叫卖。

examples.text_en: A hawker sold food near the old school.
examples.text_zh: 一个叫卖的小贩在老学校附近卖食物。

examples.text_en: The ship was tied with a thick hawser.
examples.text_zh: 船被一条粗大的系船索拴住。

examples.text_en: They pulled the hawser onto the small boat.
examples.text_zh: 他们把系船索拉上小船。

examples.text_en: The old man kept the hay in the small house.
examples.text_zh: 老人把干草存放在小房子里。

examples.text_en: They cut the hay and took it home.
examples.text_zh: 他们割下干草，带回了家。

examples.text_en: The long trip was a real hazard for us.
examples.text_zh: 这次长途旅行对我们来说是真正的危险。

examples.text_en: He did not want to take a hazard on the old road.
examples.text_zh: 他不想在旧路上冒险。

examples.text_en: The old road was too hazardous for the children.
examples.text_zh: 这条旧路对孩子来说太危险了。

examples.text_en: It was a hazardous job for a young man.
examples.text_zh: 对年轻人来说这是份危险的工作。

examples.text_en: The far hills were hazy in the morning air.
examples.text_zh: 清晨的空气中，远山显得朦胧。

examples.text_en: Her memory of that day is still hazy.
examples.text_zh: 她对那天的记忆仍然模糊。

examples.text_en: He made a headlong run into the open field.
examples.text_zh: 他轻率地朝开阔的田野跑去。

examples.text_en: It was a headlong decision that he soon felt bad about.
examples.text_zh: 那是个轻率的决定，他很快就后悔了。

examples.text_en: The headmistress talked to the whole school.
examples.text_zh: 女校长对全校讲了话。

examples.text_en: She became the headmistress of a small school.
examples.text_zh: 她成了一所小学的女校长。

examples.text_en: The headstrong boy would not listen to us.
examples.text_zh: 这个任性的男孩不肯听我们的话。

examples.text_en: She was too headstrong to change her mind.
examples.text_zh: 她太顽固了，不肯改变主意。

examples.text_en: The headteacher gave a talk to the young people.
examples.text_zh: 校长给年轻人做了一次讲话。

examples.text_en: Our headteacher worked hard for the whole school.
examples.text_zh: 我们的校长为全校辛勤工作。

examples.text_en: The team made good headway on the new work.
examples.text_zh: 团队在新工作上取得了很大进展。

examples.text_en: We could make no headway in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 在黑暗中我们无法前进。

examples.text_en: The healing of his old leg took many months.
examples.text_zh: 他旧伤的愈合花了好几个月。

examples.text_en: Time has a healing power for a sad heart.
examples.text_zh: 时间对悲伤的心有治愈的力量。

examples.text_en: Good healthcare is important for every family.
examples.text_zh: 良好的医疗保健对每个家庭都很重要。

examples.text_en: The town needs better healthcare for old people.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇需要为老人提供更好的医疗保健。

examples.text_en: A healthful life needs good food and rest.
examples.text_zh: 有益健康的生活需要好的食物和休息。

examples.text_en: They said the food was healthful for young children.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这种食物对幼儿有益健康。

examples.text_en: There was a big heap of old books in the room.
examples.text_zh: 房间里有一大堆旧书。

examples.text_en: He put the food in a heap on the table.
examples.text_zh: 他把食物堆在桌子上。

examples.text_en: The old king would hearken to the words of his people.
examples.text_zh: 老国王会倾听他的人民的话。

examples.text_en: We must hearken to the voice of the young.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须倾听年轻人的声音。

examples.text_en: We did not see it; it was only hearsay.
examples.text_zh: 我们没有亲眼看到，那只是传闻。

examples.text_en: Do not believe such hearsay about your friends.
examples.text_zh: 不要相信关于你朋友的这种传闻。

examples.text_en: She could feel her own heartbeat in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 在黑暗中她能感到自己的心跳。

examples.text_en: His heartbeat was very fast after the long run.
examples.text_zh: 长跑之后他的心跳非常快。

examples.text_en: The good news will hearten the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 这个好消息会让整个团队振作起来。

examples.text_en: Their words hearten us in the hard times.
examples.text_zh: 在艰难的时候，他们的话让我们振作。

examples.text_en: The old man sat by the hearth all night.
examples.text_zh: 老人整夜坐在炉边。

examples.text_en: They kept the hearth warm for the family.
examples.text_zh: 他们为家人把炉子烧得暖暖的。

examples.text_en: It was a heartrending story about the lost child.
examples.text_zh: 那是一个关于失踪孩子的令人心碎的故事。

examples.text_en: The heartrending news made the whole room sad.
examples.text_zh: 这个令人心碎的消息让整个房间都悲伤。

examples.text_en: His heavy-handedness made the work hard for us.
examples.text_zh: 他的笨手笨脚让我们干起活来很吃力。

examples.text_en: The heavy-handedness of the plan was clear.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划的笨拙之处很明显。

examples.text_en: Some people would heckle the young speaker.
examples.text_zh: 有些人会诘问那位年轻的演讲者。

examples.text_en: They came to heckle him at the front of the room.
examples.text_zh: 他们到房间前面来诘问他。

examples.text_en: It was a hectic day at the small office.
examples.text_zh: 对小办公室来说是忙乱的一天。

examples.text_en: The whole week was hectic for the team.
examples.text_zh: 整周对团队来说都忙乱。

examples.text_en: The old hector would not let us talk.
examples.text_zh: 那个威吓者不让我们说话。

examples.text_en: He was a hector who loved to make people feel small.
examples.text_zh: 他是个喜欢让人感到渺小的威吓者。

examples.text_en: They talked about the hedonic side of music.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到了音乐带来的快乐一面。

examples.text_en: The hedonic part of life is not the whole story.
examples.text_zh: 生活中快乐的部分并不是全部。

examples.text_en: His life of hedonism did not make him happy.
examples.text_zh: 他的享乐主义生活并没有让他快乐。

examples.text_en: They talked about hedonism in the history class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在历史课上谈到享乐主义。

examples.text_en: The young hedonist cared only about his own joy.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻的享乐主义者只关心自己的快乐。

examples.text_en: He was a hedonist who loved good food and song.
examples.text_zh: 他是个热爱美食和歌唱的享乐主义者。

examples.text_en: The heedless boy ran into the old street.
examples.text_zh: 这个不注意的男孩跑进了老街。

examples.text_en: He was heedless of the danger in the deep water.
examples.text_zh: 他对深水里的危险毫不在意。

examples.text_en: The old country had hegemony over the whole area.
examples.text_zh: 这个古国曾对整个地区拥有霸权。

examples.text_en: Their hegemony did not last for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们的霸权没有持续很多年。

examples.text_en: The music helped to heighten the feeling in the room.
examples.text_zh: 音乐加强了房间里的情绪。

examples.text_en: They tried to heighten the light on the stage.
examples.text_zh: 他们设法提高舞台上的灯光。

examples.text_en: It was a heinous thing to do to a child.
examples.text_zh: 对孩子做这种事是可憎的。

examples.text_en: The whole town talked about the heinous act.
examples.text_zh: 全镇都议论这桩可憎的行为。

examples.text_en: The old man did not know who his heir was.
examples.text_zh: 老人不知道自己的继承人是谁。

examples.text_en: She was the only heir to the family home.
examples.text_zh: 她是这处祖宅唯一的继承人。

examples.text_en: This old box is a family heirloom.
examples.text_zh: 这个旧盒子是一件传家宝。

examples.text_en: She kept the heirloom in a safe place.
examples.text_zh: 她把传家宝放在安全的地方。

examples.text_en: The heliotrope has a soft and lovely color.
examples.text_zh: 天芥菜有柔和可爱的颜色。

examples.text_en: They planted heliotrope near the small house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在小房子附近种了天芥菜。

examples.text_en: The balloon was full of helium and went up.
examples.text_zh: 气球充满氦气，升了上去。

examples.text_en: They used helium to make the big balloon.
examples.text_zh: 他们用氦气来做那个大气球。

examples.text_en: The old man took the helm and steered the boat.
examples.text_zh: 老人掌舵，驾驶着小船。

examples.text_en: She was at the helm for the whole trip.
examples.text_zh: 整个旅程都由她掌舵。

examples.text_zh: 这个奴隶不得不为同一户人家干活。

examples.text_en: They talked about the life of a helot in the old days.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到古时候奴隶的生活。

examples.text_en: The young helper gave us a lot of good help.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻的帮忙者给了我们很多帮助。

examples.text_en: She was a great helper to the whole team.
examples.text_zh: 她对整个团队来说是很好的帮手。

examples.text_en: The old man felt helpless in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 老人在黑暗中感到无助。

examples.text_en: They were helpless without any water or food.
examples.text_zh: 没有水和食物，他们毫无办法。

examples.text_zh: 他握住柄，移动那件旧工具。

examples.text_en: The helve was long and hard to hold.
examples.text_zh: 这个柄又长又难握。

examples.text_zh: 血友病是一种家族遗传的血液问题。

examples.text_en: The young man had hemophilia and could not play that game.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人有血友病，不能玩那种游戏。

examples.text_zh: 医生在短暂的手术中用了止血钳。

examples.text_en: She put the hemostat into a small box.
examples.text_zh: 她把止血钳放进一个小盒子里。

examples.text_en: Henceforth we will meet on the first day of the week.
examples.text_zh: 从今以后我们将在每周第一天见面。

examples.text_en: He said henceforth he would work from home.
examples.text_zh: 他说从今以后要在家工作。

examples.text_en: The henpecked man did what his wife said.
examples.text_zh: 这个怕老婆的男人照妻子说的做。

examples.text_en: They said he was a henpecked husband.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他是个怕老婆的丈夫。

examples.text_en: The first bird is a herald of the new season.
examples.text_zh: 第一只鸟是新季节的先驱。

examples.text_en: He came as a herald of good news.
examples.text_zh: 他是作为好消息的使者来的。

examples.text_en: The garden was full of herbaceous plants.
examples.text_zh: 花园里长满了草本植物。

examples.text_en: They talked about herbaceous plants in the class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在课上谈到草本植物。

examples.text_zh: 那人在地里使用了除草剂。

examples.text_en: They did not want herbicide near the food.
examples.text_zh: 他们不想让除草剂靠近食物。

examples.text_en: The herbivorous animal eats only plants.
examples.text_zh: 这种食草动物只吃植物。

examples.text_en: They saw a herbivorous animal near the water.
examples.text_zh: 他们在水边看到一只食草动物。

examples.text_en: It was a herculean task for one man.
examples.text_zh: 对一个人来说这是项艰巨的任务。

examples.text_en: He made a herculean effort to move the box.
examples.text_zh: 他使出巨大的力气去搬那个盒子。

examples.text_en: The herder took the animals to the open field.
examples.text_zh: 牧人把牲畜赶到开阔的田野。

examples.text_en: The old herder worked on the land all day.
examples.text_zh: 老牧人整天在土地上劳作。

examples.text_en: The herdsman sang a song in the early morning.
examples.text_zh: 牧人在清晨唱起歌来。

examples.text_en: The old herdsman knew every part of the land.
examples.text_zh: 老牧人熟悉这片土地的每一处。

examples.text_en: The old title was hereditary in that family.
examples.text_zh: 那个旧头衔在那个家族里是世袭的。

examples.text_en: They said the problem was hereditary.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这个问题是遗传的。

examples.text_en: Heredity plays a part in how we look.
examples.text_zh: 遗传对我们长相有一定影响。

examples.text_en: They talked about heredity in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上谈到遗传。

examples.text_en: They called his words a heresy against the old ideas.
examples.text_zh: 他们称他的话是对旧观念的异端。

examples.text_en: The young man was afraid to speak such heresy.
examples.text_zh: 这个年轻人害怕说出这样的异端。

examples.text_en: They called him a heretic for his new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 他们因为他的新想法称他为异教徒。

examples.text_en: The heretic would not change his words.
examples.text_zh: 这个异端者不肯改变自己的话。

examples.text_en: They said his ideas were heretical.
examples.text_zh: 他们说他的想法是异端的。

examples.text_en: It was a heretical book for that time.
examples.text_zh: 在那时这是一本异端的书。

examples.text_en: The food was kept in a hermetic box.
examples.text_zh: 食物被放在一个密封的盒子里。

examples.text_en: They made the room hermetic to keep it dry.
examples.text_zh: 他们把房间做成密封的以保持干燥。

examples.text_en: The old hermit lived alone in the far hills.
examples.text_zh: 老隐士独自住在远山里。

examples.text_en: A hermit does not want many friends.
examples.text_zh: 隐士不想要很多朋友。

examples.text_en: It was a heroic act to save the young child.
examples.text_zh: 救出那个孩子是英勇的行为。

examples.text_en: They told a heroic story about the old war.
examples.text_zh: 他们讲了一个关于那场旧战争的英勇故事。

examples.text_en: His heroism in the war was known to all.
examples.text_zh: 他在战争中的英勇众人皆知。

examples.text_en: They talked about the heroism of the young man.
examples.text_zh: 他们谈到那个年轻人的英勇。

examples.text_en: The herpetologist studies animals like snakes.
examples.text_zh: 爬虫学者研究蛇之类的动物。

examples.text_en: She became a herpetologist after many years of study.
examples.text_zh: 经过多年学习，她成了一名爬虫学者。

examples.text_en: His heterodox ideas made the old group feel sad.
examples.text_zh: 他的非正统想法让老一辈感到难过。

examples.text_en: They did not like his heterodox way of thinking.
examples.text_zh: 他们不喜欢他非正统的思维方式。

examples.text_en: The group was heterogeneous and full of different ideas.
examples.text_zh: 这个团体成分混杂，充满各种不同的想法。

examples.text_en: They lived in a heterogeneous city with many people.
examples.text_zh: 他们住在一个居民多样的城市里。

examples.text_en: He would hew the old wood with a sharp tool.
examples.text_zh: 他会用锋利的工具砍旧木头。

examples.text_en: They hew the stone to build the wall.
examples.text_zh: 他们砍凿石头来砌墙。

examples.text_en: The old town had its heyday many years ago.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇多年前有过它的全盛期。

examples.text_en: In its heyday the school had many students.
examples.text_zh: 在全盛期，这所学校有很多学生。

examples.text_en: There was a long hiatus in the work last year.
examples.text_zh: 去年这项工作有过很长的中断。

examples.text_en: After a short hiatus, they started again.
examples.text_zh: 短暂停顿之后，他们又开始了。

examples.text_en: Some animals hibernate through the long cold winter.
examples.text_zh: 有些动物在漫长寒冷的冬天里冬眠。

examples.text_en: The old bear would hibernate in a dark cave.
examples.text_zh: 老熊会在黑暗的洞穴里冬眠。

examples.text_en: The bear was in hibernation for many months.
examples.text_zh: 那头熊冬眠了好几个月。

examples.text_en: They studied hibernation in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 他们在科学课上研究冬眠。

examples.text_en: The hidebound old man would not hear new ideas.
examples.text_zh: 这个思想偏狭的老人听不进新想法。

examples.text_en: Their hidebound rules made change very hard.
examples.text_zh: 他们死板的规矩让改变非常困难。

examples.text_en: The old wall was hideous to look at.
examples.text_zh: 那面旧墙看着很丑恶。

examples.text_en: It was a hideous thing to see in the dark.
examples.text_zh: 在黑暗中看到那东西很可怕。

examples.text_en: He had to hie to the office before the meeting.
examples.text_zh: 他得赶紧去办公室开会。

examples.text_en: They hie to the market every morning.
examples.text_zh: 他们每天早上赶去市场。

examples.text_en: The old company had a clear hierarchy of power.
examples.text_zh: 这家老公司有明确的权力等级制度。

examples.text_en: She moved up in the hierarchy after many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年后她在等级体系中升了上去。

examples.text_zh: 他们在旧墙上发现了一个象形文字。

examples.text_en: Each hieroglyph could stand for a word or a sound.
examples.text_zh: 每个象形文字可以代表一个词或一个音。

examples.text_en: The old book was full of hieroglyphic signs.
examples.text_zh: 这本古书里满是象形文字符号。

examples.text_en: They studied hieroglyphic writing for many years.
examples.text_zh: 他们研究象形文字很多年。

examples.text_zh: 他们住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。

examples.text_en: The new high-rise was the talk of the town.
examples.text_zh: 这栋新高楼成了镇上的话题。

examples.text_en: The highbrow loved art and long books.
examples.text_zh: 这位文化修养高的人喜欢艺术和长篇书籍。

examples.text_en: They called him a highbrow for his taste in music.
examples.text_zh: 他们因为他的音乐品味称他为高雅之人。

examples.text_zh: 高地寒冷，风很大。

examples.text_zh: 他们花了多天走过高地。

examples.text_zh: 这次旅行的精彩之处是那座古镇。

examples.text_en: The song was the highlight of the whole show.
examples.text_zh: 那首歌是整场演出的亮点。

examples.text_en: Some men tried to hijack the small plane.
examples.text_zh: 一些人试图劫持那架小飞机。

examples.text_en: They would hijack a car and drive away.
examples.text_zh: 他们会劫持一辆车开走。

examples.text_en: The story caused great hilarity in the room.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事让房间里笑声不断。

examples.text_en: There was much hilarity at the party last night.
examples.text_zh: 昨晚的聚会上大家非常高兴。

examples.text_en: The hillbilly knew every part of the hills.
examples.text_zh: 这个乡下人熟悉山里的每一处。

examples.text_en: They called him a hillbilly, but he was kind.
examples.text_zh: 他们叫他乡巴佬，但他很善良。

examples.text_en: He held the hilt of the old sword.
examples.text_zh: 他握着旧剑的刀把。

examples.text_en: The hilt was made of gold and stone.
examples.text_zh: 刀把由金子和石头做成。

examples.text_en: The old wall was a hindrance to our work.
examples.text_zh: 那面旧墙是我们工作的障碍。

examples.text_en: He did not want to be a hindrance to the team.
examples.text_zh: 他不想成为团队的阻碍。

examples.text_en: The old door would not close on its hinge.
examples.text_zh: 那扇旧门的铰链关不上。

examples.text_en: The hinge of the door needed a drop of oil.
examples.text_zh: 门的铰链需要滴一点油。

examples.text_en: They traveled into the hinterland by the long road.
examples.text_zh: 他们沿着长路进入内地。

examples.text_en: The hinterland was far from any big city.
examples.text_zh: 腹地离任何大城市都很远。

examples.text_en: The teacher gave us a few hints about the test.
examples.text_zh: 老师给了我们一些关于考试的提示。

examples.text_en: His words were full of hints about the future.
examples.text_zh: 他的话里满是对未来的暗示。

examples.text_en: The hippopotamus stood in the deep water.
examples.text_zh: 河马站在深水里。

examples.text_en: We saw a hippopotamus near the river.
examples.text_zh: 我们在河边看到一头河马。

examples.text_en: The hirsute old man had a long white hair.
examples.text_zh: 这个多毛的老人有长长的白头发。

examples.text_en: They said the animal was hirsute and strong.
examples.text_zh: 他们说那只动物多毛而强壮。

examples.text_en: The Hispanic family made us feel at home.
examples.text_zh: 这户西班牙裔家庭让我们感到自在。

examples.text_en: She is Hispanic and speaks two languages.
examples.text_zh: 她是西班牙裔，会说两种语言。

examples.text_en: We heard a low hiss from the dark corner.
examples.text_zh: 我们听到黑暗角落里传来低低的嘘声。

examples.text_en: The hiss of the old door made us jump.
examples.text_zh: 旧门的嘶嘶声让我们吓了一跳。

examples.text_en: Histology is the study of the body's small parts.
examples.text_zh: 组织学是研究身体微小结构的一门学问。

examples.text_en: The students learned histology in the science class.
examples.text_zh: 学生们在科学课上学习组织学。
